notes.text: English: The page assumes that (37) defines an extension structure and displays a morphism of two exact sequences. It then qualifies the construction (the verb before “le tir” is uncertain between rectifié and modifié) by requiring D_J to be connected, with the insertion “i.e. X_J connexe”; otherwise it passes to components indexed by alpha and writes the sequence component by component. This records the argument, not an independently verified exactness result.

English: The proposed intrinsic formulation changes cancelled terminology to “multigaloisiens” and refers to the fundamental groupoids. The page next records maps T^J → pi_{U/K}^{bar L} induced by x in D_J, with qualifications about inner automorphisms. The uncertain final wording is retained and the page ends at “induits par”; no continuation has been supplied.

The cancelled and live formula numbers are placed in a separate left label column, preserving their upper/lower positions without nesting the diagram macro inside display math.
